title: Admin and Accounts Assistant
description: This is an exciting new opportunity to join a friendly, growing business that takes a results-led approach to managing staff and that respects work-life balance. Affinity has 40 employees across London, Cheltenham and Dublin. This role is to support the Dublin office, which currently employs 7 fire safety engineers from a variety of backgrounds. **Key duties include:** * Completing supplier questionnaires in a timely manner * Implementing and maintaining administrative requirements for professional memberships * Collating and uploading receipts for bank reconciliations * Chasing outstanding invoices via phone and email * Arranging travel and accommodation for all team members * Answering phones and responding to client queries by email, as required * Maintaining a positive, well-functioning and welcoming office environment * Liaising with our IT department to resolve issues affecting team members * Working with the UK team to adapt admin processes for an Irish team. * Continually improving admin processes with support from the wider team. * Helping to maintain well-organised admin information on Sharepoint. * Ad hoc requests from a director or your line manager This is a full-time, hybrid position. Candidates must be able to attend the office 3 days per week. We are able to facilitate flexible hours, such as starting and finishing earlier/later to accommodate either a school pick up or drop off for those with children. Candidates must be fluent in English, must have a positive attitude and must be comfortable speaking regularly on the phone. Experience of Microsoft Office programmes is essential. At least 1 year of continuous service in a similar role is an essential requirement. **Salary & Benefits:** * €38,000 plus bonus incentives. * Gifted Fridays – following successful completion of probation, all employees work a 9 day fortnight * 34 days of annual leave, inc. bank holidays. * Hybrid working policy with a real focus on work/life balance. * Enrolment to company pension scheme (PRSA), 5% employer contribution, min. 3% employee contribution. * Modern office in central Dublin with a supportive team who respect each other

title: Assistant Psychologist
description: **Assistant Psychologist** **St Michaels House Adult Services** **24 month Specific Purpose Contract (21 hours, 3 days per week)** **(Ballymun)** This is an exciting opportunity for an Assistant Psychologist to join St. Michaels House and work with our adult service users, their families, front line staff and other clinicians. The Assistant Psychologist will carry out clinical and administrative duties that support the Psychologists and the Interdisciplinary Team in providing a high-quality service to our service users who present with complex needs arising from a disability. The Assistant Psychologist always works under the supervision of a qualified Psychologist. **The successful candidate must have the following:** ***Essential Criteria-*** *Minimum requirements for short listing* * Candidates must hold an honours graduate qualification in Psychology and be eligible for Graduate Membership of the Psychological Society of Ireland. * Work experience in a clinical or educational setting, preferably with adults with a disability, in a paid or voluntary capacity. * Evidence of an understanding of the role and practice of psychology in Disability Services. * A copy of academic certificates must be submitted with the application. ***Desirable Criteria*** * Additional qualifications or training relevant to the post. * Experience working as part of a team. * Evidence of excellent interpersonal skills and an enthusiastic and flexible attitude to work. Governance and supervision are in accordance with The Psychological Society of Ireland Guidelines for the Employment of Assistant Psychologists in Ireland. Travelling is required as part of the position and the successful applicant will need access to their own car or other suitable mode of transport as they will be traveling to various locations around Dublin. Travel costs incurred will be provided for, in line with organisational policy and procedures. **Benefits of working in St Michael's House** * HSE Pay Scale (incremental\*) * Premium Payments (Frontline staff) * Generous Annual Leave * Public Pension Scheme * Career Progression * Sick Pay Scheme * Paid Maternity Leave * Cycle to Work Scheme * Employee Assistance Programme * Training / CPD * Career Progression **Salary Scale**: The successful candidate will be paid in line with the June 2026 HSE revised consolidated Psychology Assistant pay scale (point 1; 34,410 pro rata which is based on working a 35 hour week. Salary for working 21 hours per week is 20,646 per annum). **Please note this salary scale only has 1 point.** **A panel (12 months) will be created for future employment opportunities, in St Michaels House Adult Services.** To apply: please email both your cover letter and a copy of your CV via Rezoomo. Queries to: Dr Sandra McNulty, Principal Psychology Manager in Adult Services sandra.mcnulty@smh.ie **Closing date for receipt of applications is Monday 30th November at 12 noon** *As only candidates shortlisted for interview will be contacted, please include a valid email address on application.* **Candidates should note that canvassing will disqualify them.** **St. Michaels House is an equal opportunities employer.**

title: Behaviour Specialist
description: **Behaviour Specialist** **St Michaels House Adult Autism Services** **Full-time permanent contract** This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Behavioural Therapist to join the Psychology Department in Adult Services in St Michaels House. The successful candidate will be supporting adults with both an intellectual disability and autism. This is a dynamic role that requires a candidate with excellent skills in assessing and implementing positive behaviour support plans, and working with service users, front line staff and other clinicians to ensure that service users are being supported to live their best lives. The successful candidate will work across a number of locations in Dublin, with a base in either Ballymun HQ or Coolock, Adare Green. This can be discussed and agreed at a later date. **The successful candidate must have the following:** ***Essential Criteria-*** *Minimum requirements for short listing* **Formal Education/Training** * A PSI accredited undergraduate Degree in Psychology or other relevant level 8 Degree (e.g. Nursing, Social Care). * A Masters Degree in Applied Behaviour Analysis * We also welcome applications from Behavioural Psychologists who are chartered by PSI and from those currently completing their post graduate supervised practice hours in pursuit of chartership. **Work Experience** * Minimum of four years supervised experience working in behaviour support roles: carrying out functional assessments; developing positive behaviour support plans; supporting and coaching social care staff teams to implement interventions for people with intellectual disabilities and/or Autism. * Experience developing adaptive/functional skills training programmes for people with intellectual disabilities and/or Autism. * Experience working collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary clinical team. * Demonstrated history of caseload management and good organisational skills * A copy of academic certificates must be submitted with the application. ***Desirable Criteria*** * High level understanding of Autism * Evidence of excellent interpersonal skills and an enthusiastic and flexible attitude to work. * Additional qualifications or training relevant to the post. Governance and supervision are in accordance with The Psychological Society of Ireland Guidelines for the Employment of Assistant Psychologists in Ireland. Travelling is required as part of the position and the successful applicant will need access to their own car or other suitable mode of transport as they will be traveling to various locations around Dublin. title: Billing Specialist
description: **Department: Billing** **Employment Type: Full Time** **Location: Hybrid - Sandyford, Dublin 18** **Salary: 36k OTE** As a member of the Revenue Assurance team, the primary responsibility of the Billing Specialist is to ensure complete, timely and accurate billing of customers. We are looking for a target-driven Billing Specialist to work with the growing Revenue Protection team across the PrepayPower/Yuno billing team. This role requires an individual who has the ability to work on their own initiative and develop procedures and processes as the business continues to grow. The ideal candidate will be highly target-driven with strong experience working with Microsoft excel preferably in a utilities billing role. The role will involve a high level of excel based billing work and the successful candidate will be required to improve and streamline the existing billing process. **Key Responsibilities** * Ensuring all billing activities are completed accurately and on time. * Calculation and preparation of customer invoices * Setup and management of tariffs on the charging systems * Management of the Billing communications process . * Investigating and resolving exceptional billing queries from customers and other departments internally. * Carryout analysis and reconciliations to confirm accuracy of processes. * Liaising with other departments and 3rd parties, to identify and resolve billing issues. Assessing impacts and making recommendations to prevent recurrence. * Develop and implement new reports to track process performance. * Calculation and management of customer refunds. * Liaising with IT and Development departments re billing process improvement. * Providing an insight of existing processes and potential scope for automation. * Providing regular reports to the Snr Billing Specialist/Team Lead on all billing activity on a weekly & monthly basis. * Become a subject matter expert in Gas, Electricity, Broadband and Oil products in order to identify potential gaps in the revenue streams. * Carryout adhoc activities as needed. **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise** * Proven ability to work to strict targets to achieve individual and team objectives. * Hold a minimum qualification of a bachelor’s degree (Level 8) or minimum 1 years’ experience is a similar role. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams. * Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), with advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.). * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. * Proven ability to work in a self-directed and organised manner. * Ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks effectively. * Experience of working with a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system would be beneficial. * Previous utilities experience is preferred with energy supplier experience would be a distinct advantage. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and bonus structure * Private Pension Contribution Scheme with Zurich Life * Discounted Health Insurance - Group Scheme with Laya Healthcare * Employee Assistance Program provided by TELUS Health * Free Online GP Services via Webdoctor.ie * Excellent career progression opportunities in a growing company with strong market presence * Fast-paced, friendly team environment * Continuous training and development * Annual leave that increases with service * Exclusive Employee Discount * Active CSR, Wellness, and Social initiatives plus great social events * Refer-a-Friend Scheme * TaxSaver Travel Tickets & Bike-to-Work Scheme **About PrepayPower** PrepayPower is the leading provider of Pay-As-You-Go electricity and gas in Ireland. Since 2011, we have been disrupting the energy market by empowering customers with total control and transparency over their electricity costs through our app. PrepayPower’s mission is to give people total control and complete transparency over their energy costs. Rather than the traditional market model of short-term discounts with significant contract terms, we help customers achieve long-term savings on their electricity, gas, oil and broadband by putting them in control. Customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do. Our commitment to providing exceptional service has earned us the title of Ireland’s highest-rated energy supplier on Trustpilot. In 2025, together with Yuno Energy, we proudly reached over 350,000 customer connections. **Why work at PrepayPower** Ranked as a top employer for seven consecutive years by Great Places to Work Ireland, we offer ambitious individuals a fast-paced and challenging work environment with enormous opportunities for growth. PrepayPower is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all our employees, customers, and stakeholders with dignity and respect. Therefore, we value diverse talent and strive to create an inclusive workplace that delivers exceptional, innovative services for our customers. We encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. PrepayPower is part of the Yuno Group alongside a suite of brands, including Yuno Energy and firmus Energy. With almost 600 employees and growing, we are the market leader for Pay-as-You-Go Electricity, Gas, and Broadband in Ireland. Join us and become part of a dynamic, ambitious team that’s putting control in the hands of our customers. **Privacy** By applying for this role, you agree to PrepayPower processing your personal data for recruitment purposes. We handle all applications in line with our Privacy Notice. You can view our privacy notice here Careers - Privacy Policy | PrePayPower for more information.

title: Business Development Representative
description: **About Wayflyer** Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer. Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan. You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. **The challenge** We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist. **What You'll Actually Do** You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right. **What This Role Could Turn Into** We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there. We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are. **Who Thrives Here** You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point. **We hire for range** We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement. **Location and working policy** **📍** Dublin HQ, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office) **The good stuff** 25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

title: Cabin Crew Recruitment Day - Dublin - 20 November 2026
description: Would you like to be part of the Ryanair Group's amazing cabin crew family of 16k+ crew? If you are customer-oriented, love delivering great service & want fast-track career opportunities, we would be delighted to hear from you! No experience is required, just bags of enthusiasm & team spirit! Crew link, recruitment partner of Ryanair Group are currently recruiting for Cabin Crew in Dublin. They will be holding a Recruitment Day in Dublin, apply now! **Date: Dublin 20h November 2026** **You will be invited to attend once your application has been reviewed.** As Europe’s largest airline group carrying over 600K guests on over 3,600 daily flights, we are looking for the next generation of cabin crew to join us in the Autumn/Winter months at one of **our 90+ operational bases** . Flying on board Ryanair Group aircraft there are some amazing perks, including; discounted staff travel to over 250+ destinations across the Ryanair network, a fixed roster pattern, free training & industry-leading pay. **Job Description** Your journey to becoming a qualified cabin crew member will start on a 6-week training course where you will learn all of the fundamental skills that you will require as part of your day-to-day role delivering a top-class safety & customer service experience to our guests. During the course you will be required to study with exams taking place at regular intervals, the training culminates with Supernumerary flights, followed by your Cabin Crew Wings. As a member of the Ryanair Group cabin crew family, you will be immersed into our culture from day one, the career opportunities are endless including becoming a number 1, base supervisor, Regional Manager or why not aspire to becoming our Director of Inflight? Life as Cabin Crew is fun & rewarding, it is however a demanding position where safety is our number 1 priority. You will be required to operate both early & late shifts & report for duty as early as 5 am in the morning on the early roster & not return home until midnight on the afternoon roster. If you are not a morning person, then think twice before applying! **This Recruitment Event will be held by our official Cabin Crew Recruitment Partner - CrewLink.** **Qualifications** * Applicants must hold the unrestricted right to live and work in the EU and / or travel freely throughout the Ryanair Network * You must approximately be between 5 “2 (157 cm) and 6” 2 (188 cm) in height. * You must be able to swim 25 meters unaided, and supporting someone else * It helps if you are hardworking, flexible and have an outgoing and friendly personality. * Adaptable and happy to work a shift roster. * Enjoy dealing with the public and have the ability to provide excellent customer service with a ‘can do’ attitude. * Comfortable speaking and writing in English with the ability to successfully pass an English Language Assessment * A passion for travelling and meeting new people. **Additional Information** * Free Internationally recognised Cabin Crew Training Course * Paid training allowance * A once off Joining Bonus of €2000 * Uncapped Sales bonus, increasing your earning potential * Unlimited highly discounted Staff Travel across all of Ryanair's network. Further benefits available after 12 months * Fixed 5 days on / 3 days off roster pattern * The adventure and experience of a lifetime within our Cabin Crew network * Explore new cultures and cities with colleagues on your days off * Free Uniform in Year 1 and annual allowance afterwards * Security of working for a financially stable Airline

title: Clinical Sample Processor I
description: ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster. As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers. As a Clinical Sample Processor I at ICON, you will the collection, processing, and tracking of clinical trial samples to ensure accurate and timely analysis, contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies. **What You Will Do** Your role will involve delivering process improvement and operational excellence work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities Include** * Collecting, receiving, and logging clinical trial samples according to study protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs). * Processing samples using various laboratory techniques and equipment, ensuring proper handling and storage conditions. * Performing data entry and maintaining accurate records of sample receipt, processing, and distribution. * Participating in inventory management activities, including ordering supplies and maintaining stock levels. * Assisting with the disposal of samples and hazardous waste in compliance with regulatory requirements. **Your Profile** You will bring relevant process improvement and operational excellence experience, along with the following qualifications and skills. **Required Qualifications And Experience** * Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Previous experience in a laboratory or clinical research setting preferred. * Familiarity with laboratory techniques and equipment used for sample processing. * Strong attention to detail and ability to follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety guidelines. * Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. **What ICON Can Offer You** Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent. In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. title: NOC Engineer
description: Our client is a rapidly growing AI Hyperscaler at the forefront of next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure\*\*, building the high-performance computing and networking environments that power some of the world's most demanding artificial intelligence workloads. Operating in one of the fastest-growing areas of technology, the business is investing heavily in scalable infrastructure, advanced networking and cutting-edge technologies to support the increasing global demand for AI compute. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career network engineer or technically minded individual looking to build their expertise in a large-scale, mission-critical networking environment. Working within a 24/7 operations team, you will be responsible for monitoring network performance, responding to alarms, investigating incidents and carrying out first-line troubleshooting to help maintain network stability. You'll work closely with experienced Network Operations Engineers and Team Leads, gaining hands-on exposure to optical transport technologies, IP networking, multi-vendor equipment and industry-leading operational practices. The role offers structured training, mentorship and clear opportunities to develop your technical capabilities within the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure sector. Key Responsibilities Network Monitoring & Incident Management - Monitor the health, availability and performance of optical and IP networks within a 24/7 Network Operations Centre. - Identify, acknowledge and prioritise network alarms, events and incidents in line with established service levels and operational procedures. - Carry out first-line troubleshooting across optical technologies (DWDM, CWDM) and IP networks (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP and OSPF). - Perform initial diagnostic checks, including optical power levels, interface status, network connectivity, protocol adjacencies and alarm conditions. - Analyse network logs, performance data and recent changes to support fault identification and resolution. - Escalate complex technical issues to senior Network Operations Engineers, providing clear diagnostics and details of troubleshooting already completed. - Assist during major network incidents by gathering technical information, performing diagnostic checks and maintaining accurate incident records. Ticketing, Documentation & Communication - Create, manage and update incident tickets, ensuring all troubleshooting activities and resolutions are accurately documented. - Engage with equipment vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia and Infinera, to support technical investigations and fault resolution. - Track outstanding incidents and vendor support cases, ensuring appropriate follow-up and progression. - Verify network service restoration following incidents and document the outcomes. - Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams, stakeholders and customers using established communication processes. Network Maintenance & Change Support - Assist senior engineers with planned network maintenance, upgrades and infrastructure changes. - Carry out pre- and post-maintenance checks to help ensure network stability and service continuity. - Follow approved change management processes, technical procedures and Methods of Procedure (MOPs). - Support the provisioning, activation and testing of new network circuits, services and equipment. - Coordinate with field engineers, data centre and colocation providers, ISPs and external service partners to support troubleshooting and maintenance activities. ### Technical Development & Collaboration - Build practical knowledge of optical networking, IP routing and network operations through structured training and hands-on experience. - Work alongside experienced engineers to develop troubleshooting and incident management capabilities. - Contribute to technical documentation, operational procedures and internal knowledge resources. - Participate in shift handovers, ensuring clear communication of outstanding incidents, operational risks and ongoing activities. - Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure and wider technical teams to support a reliable and resilient network environment. - Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and network monitoring practices. ## What We're Looking For We're interested in individuals with a strong technical foundation, a genuine interest in networking and the motivation to develop within a fast-growing technology environment. \*\*Essential Skills & Experience\*\* - 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT infrastructure, technical support or a related field. Relevant internships, academic projects and hands-on lab experience will also be considered. - A degree or technical qualification in Networking, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. - Foundational understanding of IP networking, including TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, routing and switching. - Basic knowledge of routing protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF and MPLS. - An understanding of optical networking concepts, including DWDM, CWDM, fibre optics and optical power levels. - Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). - Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to technical troubleshooting. - Good communication skills and the ability to produce clear technical documentation. €55k
